name: math-cages
description: Printable math cage puzzles with one solution and an answer key.

interface.longDescription:
Make printable math cage puzzles for teachers, students and puzzle fans as a PDF with an answer key. Zovo Math Cages builds arithmetic cage puzzles from 4 x 4 to 9 x 9: fill each row and column with the numbers 1 to N once, and make each outlined cage reach its target with its sign.

Choose the operations the class is practising: addition only, addition and subtraction, multiplication and division, or all four. Subtraction and division cages have 2 cells. Pick easy, medium or hard; harder puzzles have bigger cages and fewer single-number cells.

Before the PDF is made, a solver checks that each puzzle has one solution. The reply lists each puzzle with its size, number of cages, single-number cells and the solver steps it took, as a rough difficulty signal.

The PDF puts 1, 2 or 4 puzzles on each page, on US Letter or A4, with an optional title and a name and date line for worksheets. Cages have thick borders with the target and sign in the corner. Answer pages at the end show each solved grid in the same place. Up to 12 puzzles fit in one PDF.

Each puzzle has a seed. The same seed and settings give the same puzzle again, so a teacher can reprint a sheet next term.

Limitations: grids are square from 4 x 4 to 9 x 9 with the numbers 1 to N (no zero and no larger numbers), puzzles with only subtraction or division have many single-number cells, it does not solve a puzzle from a photo, and titles print in Latin, Greek and Cyrillic letters (Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Hebrew and emoji are left out of the PDF).
defaultPrompt: Make 4 easy 4x4 math cage puzzles with addition only, 2 per page, titled Number Fun, seed 11
Make a hard 6x6 math cage puzzle with all four operations on A4, seed 42
Make 2 medium 5x5 math cage puzzles with addition and subtraction only, 2 per page, seed 300

positive.prompt: Make 4 easy 4x4 math cage puzzles with addition only for my class, 2 per page, titled Number Fun, seed 11
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_math_cages once with count 4, size 4, operations addition only, difficulty easy, per_page 2. The reply says each 4 x 4 puzzle has one solution, seeds 11 to 14, and gives a PDF link with 4 Letter pages: 2 puzzle pages and 2 answer key pages.

positive.prompt: Make a hard 6x6 math cage puzzle with all four operations on A4, seed 42
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_math_cages once with size 6, difficulty hard, paper a4. The reply gives a 6 x 6 puzzle with 16 cages and 4 single-number cells, checked for one solution, and a 2 page A4 PDF with the answer key.

positive.prompt: Make 2 medium 5x5 math cage puzzles with addition and subtraction only, 2 per page, seed 300
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_math_cages once with count 2, size 5, operations addition and subtraction. The reply lists 2 puzzles with 10 and 9 cages, seeds 300 and 301, and a 2 page PDF (1 puzzle page and 1 answer page).

positive.prompt: One easy 4x4 addition-only puzzle (seed 9), one medium 6x6 (seed 10) and one hard 9x9 (seed 11), all signs for the last two, 2 per page
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_math_cages once with 3 objects in puzzles. The reply lists the 3 puzzles; the 4 x 4 has 7 cages, the 6 x 6 has 15 cages and the 9 x 9 has 29 cages. The PDF has 4 pages: 2 puzzle pages and 2 answer pages.

positive.prompt: A hard 9x9 math cage puzzle with + - x and /, no answer key and no name line, seed 77
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_math_cages once with size 9, difficulty hard, answer_key false, name_line false. The reply says the puzzle has 30 cages and 3 single-number cells with one solution, and the PDF is 1 page.

negative.description: Solving a puzzle from a photo is out of scope. Expected: the tool is not called; the assistant says this plugin makes new puzzles and does not read puzzle photos.
negative.prompt: Here is a photo of the cage puzzle from today's newspaper, what goes in the top row?

negative.description: A plain sudoku is a different puzzle. Expected: the tool is not called; the assistant explains this plugin makes math cage puzzles, not classic sudoku with given digits.
negative.prompt: Make me a classic 9x9 sudoku with given numbers

negative.description: Arithmetic help is not this job. Expected: the tool is not called; the assistant answers the math question without this plugin.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.0.0: math cage puzzles from 4 x 4 to 9 x 9 with chosen operations, one solution checked by a solver, 1, 2 or 4 per page, Letter or A4, answer key pages.

pl-PL.subtitle: Łamigłówki z klatkami
pl-PL.description: Łamigłówki matematyczne z klatkami do druku dla nauczycieli i uczniów, jako PDF z kluczem odpowiedzi. Siatki od 4 x 4 do 9 x 9: w każdym wierszu i kolumnie liczby od 1 do N po jednym razie, a każda klatka daje swój wynik podanym działaniem. Wybierz działania (tylko dodawanie, dodawanie i odejmowanie, wszystkie cztery) i poziom trudności. Solver sprawdza, że każda łamigłówka ma jedno rozwiązanie. 1, 2 lub 4 na stronie, Letter lub A4, tytuł i linia na imię, na końcu strony z odpowiedziami. Ten sam seed daje tę samą łamigłówkę.

de-DE.subtitle: Rechenrätsel mit Käfigen
de-DE.description: Rechenrätsel mit Käfigen zum Ausdrucken für Lehrkräfte und Schüler, als PDF mit Lösungsseiten. Gitter von 4 x 4 bis 9 x 9: jede Zeile und Spalte enthält die Zahlen 1 bis N einmal, und jeder Käfig ergibt mit seinem Rechenzeichen die Zielzahl. Wähle die Rechenarten (nur Plus, Plus und Minus, alle vier) und die Schwierigkeit. Ein Löser prüft, dass jedes Rätsel eine Lösung hat. 1, 2 oder 4 pro Seite, Letter oder A4, Titel und Namenszeile, am Ende die Lösungen. Derselbe Seed ergibt dasselbe Rätsel.

es-ES.subtitle: Acertijos de jaulas
es-ES.description: Acertijos matemáticos de jaulas para imprimir para docentes y estudiantes, en PDF con solucionario. Cuadrículas de 4 x 4 a 9 x 9: cada fila y columna lleva los números del 1 al N una vez, y cada jaula alcanza su resultado con su signo. Elige las operaciones (solo suma, suma y resta, las cuatro) y la dificultad. Un solucionador comprueba que cada acertijo tiene una sola solución. 1, 2 o 4 por página, Carta o A4, título y línea para el nombre, y al final las soluciones. La misma semilla da el mismo acertijo.

fr-FR.subtitle: Casse-têtes à cages
fr-FR.description: Casse-têtes de calcul à cages à imprimer pour enseignants et élèves, en PDF avec corrigé. Grilles de 4 x 4 à 9 x 9 : chaque ligne et colonne contient les nombres de 1 à N une fois, et chaque cage atteint son résultat avec son signe. Choisissez les opérations (addition seule, addition et soustraction, les quatre) et la difficulté. Un solveur vérifie que chaque grille a une seule solution. 1, 2 ou 4 par page, Letter ou A4, titre et ligne pour le nom, puis les pages de corrigé. La même graine redonne la même grille.

ja-JP.subtitle: 印刷用の計算ケージパズル
ja-JP.description: 先生と生徒のための印刷用計算ケージパズルを、答えのページ付きPDFで作ります。4 x 4から9 x 9のマスに、各行と各列へ1からNの数を1回ずつ入れ、太線で囲んだケージは記号の計算で目標の数になります。足し算だけ、足し算と引き算、四則すべてなどの計算と、難しさを選べます。ソルバーで各問題の答えが1つだけであることを確認します。1ページに1、2、4問、レターまたはA4、タイトルと名前欄付き。同じシードで同じ問題をもう一度作れます。

pt-BR.subtitle: Quebra-cabeças de gaiolas
pt-BR.description: Quebra-cabeças matemáticos de gaiolas para imprimir para professores e alunos, em PDF com gabarito. Grades de 4 x 4 a 9 x 9: cada linha e coluna tem os números de 1 a N uma vez, e cada gaiola chega ao seu resultado com o seu sinal. Escolha as operações (só adição, adição e subtração, as quatro) e a dificuldade. Um solucionador confere que cada quebra-cabeça tem uma só solução. 1, 2 ou 4 por página, Carta ou A4, título e linha para o nome, e no final o gabarito. A mesma semente gera o mesmo quebra-cabeça.
